report.summary: Analyzed chunk 8 of 12 of session.py: contains planning function, role assignment, local host detection, and default participant builder.
risks: plan_session docstring | medium | Claims no adapter method that could reach a vendor is touched, but imports of adapter classes (though not called) are present. To settle, verify that no adapter methods are invoked anywhere in the function body.
_is_local_http | low | Uses regex to match host; may not cover all loopback aliases (e.g., '127.0.0.2'). To settle, check if the function is used for security-critical decisions.

default_participants docstring | medium | Claims Ollama host is passed explicitly and OLLAMA_HOST is neither read nor written; but the function reads DEFAULT_BENCH_OLLAMA_HOST imported from vendors. To settle, confirm that DEFAULT_BENCH_OLLAMA_HOST does not read OLLAMA_HOST.

default_participants docstring | medium | Claims lanes come from council profiles, not from a default argument; but the function does not set lanes here. To settle, verify that the adapters' lanes are set externally.

claims.text: Exactly what :func:`convene` would do, WITHOUT calling anything.
claims.why: The function body does not call any vendor adapter methods; it only constructs dictionaries and performs pure computations.

claims.text: No adapter method that could reach a vendor is touched: only the identity properties (actor, independence class, lane), which are pure.
claims.why: The function only accesses .actor, .independence_class, .lane, .vendor, .model, .endpoint, .text_tokens(), .label, .digest, .paths, .files, which are identity or pure properties.

claims.text: True only for a loopback HTTP endpoint. ``localhost``-ish and nothing else.
claims.why: The function checks if the host is in _LOCAL_HOSTS which contains loopback addresses and 'localhost'.

claims.text: "Local" was a property of an environment variable nobody had ever set; here it is a property of the RESOLVED host, checked, not asserted.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain information about any environment variable; the claim refers to external context.

claims.text: Lanes come from the council profiles, NOT from a default argument here: ``codex`` and ``agy`` are ``untrusted`` (allow-list tier ON) unless the operator opts in per council.
claims.why: The chunk does not show how lanes are set; the adapters are constructed without lane argument here.

claims.text: The Ollama host is passed EXPLICITLY and ``OLLAMA_HOST`` is neither read for routing nor written -- normalising a remote Ollama into this process would retroactively falsify ``offload.py``'s ``lane="trusted"`` justification from a code path nobody edited.
claims.why: The function reads DEFAULT_BENCH_OLLAMA_HOST from vendors, but the chunk does not show whether that constant reads OLLAMA_HOST. The reference to offload.py is outside this chunk.

observations.what: plan_session docstring claims no adapter method is touched, but the function does not call any adapter methods; it only uses properties. The claim is accurate.
_is_local_http uses a regex that may not capture all loopback aliases (e.g., 127.0.0.2).
default_participants imports adapter classes but does not call them yet; the function body is truncated at the end of the chunk.
default_participants docstring claims lanes come from council profiles, but the function does not set lanes. This may be addressed by external code.
